nodes.description: Immutable ERC20 token contract being held by the timelock.
Immutable address of the beneficiary who receives tokens after release.
Immutable timestamp when token release becomes enabled.
Constructor that validates releaseTime_ against block.timestamp and initializes token, beneficiary and release time.
Public view returning the held token address.
Public view returning the beneficiary address.
Public view returning the release timestamp.
Transfers the timelocked token balance to the beneficiary once block.timestamp passes the release time.
Public view returning the current token balance held by the timelock.
Block timestamp used for release-time gating and constructor validation.
External ERC20 transfer call to the beneficiary that can execute untrusted code and reenter.
Constructor parameter for the ERC20 token to be held.
Constructor parameter for the beneficiary address.
Constructor parameter for the release timestamp.
Local variable holding the token balance to transfer in release().
Local variable holding the current locked token balance in getLockedAmount().

edges.reason: Constructor parameter token_ is assigned to the _token state variable.
Constructor parameter beneficiary_ is assigned to the _beneficiary state variable.
Constructor parameter releaseTime_ is assigned to the _releaseTime state variable.
Constructor requires releaseTime_ > block.timestamp, making deployment dependent on block time.
release() gates execution on block.timestamp >= releaseTime(), a timestamp dependency.
release() calls releaseTime() to obtain the comparison value.
release() reads token() (backed by _token) to query the balance.
getLockedAmount() reads token() (backed by _token) to query the balance.
The beneficiary address (derived from _beneficiary) is the recipient of the external safeTransfer call.
release() invokes the external token safeTransfer with the computed amount, transferring control to an external contract.
The external token transfer can call back into release() before state effects settle, enabling reentrancy.
Local amount is derived from the token balance and passed into the transfer within release().
Local amount is derived from the token balance and returned by getLockedAmount().

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter token_ only feeds initialization of the _token state variable in the constructor.
Constructor parameter beneficiary_ only feeds initialization of the _beneficiary state variable in the constructor.
Constructor parameter releaseTime_ is validated and stored within the constructor only.
Local amount in release() is computed from the balance and passed directly into the external safeTransfer call.
Local amount in getLockedAmount() is a transient return value confined to that view function.
